authorised_by: THE USER, explicitly. The architect is gate owner and reviewer, not approver.
what_this_authorises: writing to disk, ONCE, the dataset that v26c_j7_markov_dataset.assemble() already produces in memory and that the J7 preflight has audited. It authorises nothing else.
frozen_inputs_note: these three files are FROZEN. The materializer refuses to run if any byte of them differs. It never edits them and never reimplements assemble(). frozen_inputs below is a pure path -> sha256 map and carries nothing else.

bootstrap.rule: v26c_j7_markov_dataset.py is authenticated byte-for-byte against its frozen hash BEFORE it is imported or executed. Authentication that happens after exec is not authentication.
bootstrap.loading: importlib.util.spec_from_file_location on the exact builder path, then exec_module. Never an import by name, which would search sys.path and could execute a namesake.
bootstrap.preloaded_module: FAIL CLOSED. If a module of the builder's name is already present in sys.modules, this layer refuses outright - even when its __file__ and hash match the frozen builder. Those bytes executed before this layer authenticated them, so it cannot attest to what ran: identity is not provenance, and hashing the file on disk today says nothing about what was executed earlier. There is no reuse branch. The materializer must run in a process that has not already imported the builder.
bootstrap.post_load: the loaded module's __file__ and hash are re-checked, and the bootstrap trace must show the builder's verification before its execution
bootstrap.on_mismatch: refuse before any import or execution

destination.resolution: the leaf is ALWAYS <root>/j7_runs/j7_markov_dataset_v26c_2026-08-26_r1. The relative part is not overridable under any flag. Only the root can be redirected, by an explicit in-process test override that stamps the receipt as non-authoritative.
destination.write_protocol: atomic commit, no-clobber under exclusive materializer lock: acquire a sibling lock with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, create a sibling staging directory, write and round-trip verify the bytes there, re-check the leaf immediately before committing, then rename the staging onto the leaf.

lock.sibling_of: the leaf, inside j7_runs - never inside the leaf itself
lock.does_not_guarantee: nothing is claimed against a writer that ignores the lock. os.rename on POSIX will silently replace an existing EMPTY directory, so the rename alone is not a no-clobber primitive; the lock plus the re-check immediately before the rename close that window between materializer instances only.
lock.if_it_pre_exists: FAIL CLOSED. The run stops, reports the lock, and removes NO lock it does not own - stale or live is not a distinction it is allowed to make.
lock.released_by: only the run that created it, on success after the rename and on failure during cleanup

cleanup_on_failure.staging: shutil.rmtree, ONLY on the exact staging directory this run created
cleanup_on_failure.lock: unlinked only if this run created it
cleanup_on_failure.parent: at most a NON-RECURSIVE rmdir, only if this run created it and only if it is empty; the error is ignored when it is not
cleanup_on_failure.never: no recursive removal of j7_runs, and no removal of anything this run did not create. Content that appeared concurrently survives.

authorised_outputs.no_other_file: the leaf holds exactly these two files and nothing else

dataset_contract.content_hash_definition: sha256 over the array dtype, shape and C-contiguous bytes, as v26c_j7_markov_dataset._sha_array computes it
dataset_contract.if_the_content_hash_differs: REFUSE. The dataset written must be bit-identical to the one the preflight audited, or it is a different dataset.

must_record: the pinned hashes of every input
the sha256 of the dataset file on disk
the per-seed penetration summary, produced by the contract evaluator

this_stage_does_not: construct, reset or step an environment
touch the critic or run PPO
recompute, filter, dedup, downsample or reorder the dataset
modify FSM, morphology, reward, SEA or the C++ plugin
modify the J2 parent or any existing artefact
promote anything or authorise a next stage

outcome_policy.no_autonomous_retry: on failure the evidence is preserved and the run stops
